dict.string: SplitBar uses your approximate location to show local weather and, if you enable it, your Wi-Fi network name. Nothing is sent anywhere except the weather service you choose.
SplitBar lists your paired Bluetooth devices in Quick Settings so you can see and reconnect them. It does not use Bluetooth for anything else.

SplitBar asks other apps to perform actions you requested, such as revealing a file in Finder, closing a window, or reading a music player's now-playing status. It only does this when you click the corresponding control.
